cache_contract: cold application caches; OS caches are not evicted; sequential engine runs

fixture.change_distribution: first one percent of file IDs, distributed across directories

profiling_contract: Flat spans overlap and are not additive. Observed native lifetime includes pipe backpressure and caller parsing before wait; it is not pure engine CPU. Popen time is measured separately. Native CPU uses RUSAGE_CHILDREN differences with sequential owned child commands. Linux RSS/threads are observed every20ms; peaks are lower-bound observations. No argv, environment, key material or native output is retained.
storage: disposable local format-2 repositories; synthetic catalog/keyset callbacks
